description: Preparers enter source data and prepare returns; reviewers check and approve
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Peak-season values (February 1 to April 15; October 1 to 15): about $145K of work per business day; a lost day near a deadline means late returns and penalties charged to clients; vendor SaaS RPO 1 h
manual_workaround: File extensions (Form 4868 and business equivalents) for unfinished clients; prioritize by deadline; paper preparation only as a last resort
dependent_people_or_facilities: Preparers and reviewers; both offices or remote

description: Release signed returns for e-file through the vendor; track IRS and state acknowledgments and rejects
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Returns must be transmitted by the deadline; acknowledgments prove timely filing; vendor transmits (SaaS RPO 1 h)
manual_workaround: Extensions filed through the vendor or IRS e-file when available; paper filing with proof of mailing
dependent_third_parties: Tax software vendor (Authorized e-file transmitter); IRS and state e-file systems

description: Receive source documents through the portal, mail, and drop-off; scan, index, and file to the DMS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Preparers stall without documents; clients keep originals so lost scans can be re-collected; DMS backed up daily (RPO 24 h); portal vendor retains uploads
manual_workaround: Preparers work from paper originals; portal uploads accessed directly in the portal
dependent_people_or_facilities: Intake and scanning staff; Main office

description: Clients sign Forms 8879 and engagement letters and download returns in the portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The ERO may not transmit until Form 8879 is signed (IRS Pub. 1345); wet signature fallback exists
manual_workaround: Wet-signature Form 8879 by in-person visit or mail; returns delivered on paper

description: Email, phones, and portal messages with clients and IRS or state agencies
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadline questions and document requests peak in season; email is also the BEC attack path; mailbox data kept by vendor
manual_workaround: Phone tree; temporary out-of-band email notice on the website; portal messages

description: Plan, perform, and document audits, reviews, and compilations in the workpaper application
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Report dates are set by client and lender deadlines, usually with some slack; workpaper server backed up daily (RPO 24 h)
manual_workaround: Work offline in local engagement files; reschedule fieldwork

business_process: IRS and state notice response and representation
description: Respond to IRS and state notices and examinations for clients within the notice deadlines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most notices allow 30 days or more; deadlines can often be extended by phone
manual_workaround: Call the agency for more time; work from paper copies

description: Projections, planning memos, and bookkeeping reviews for business clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No regulatory deadlines; work can shift by days
manual_workaround: Reschedule meetings; work from local files

description: Time capture, invoicing, and client payments through the hosted payment page
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow peaks in April and October; invoices can be delayed a few days; vendor SaaS retains data

description: Firm payroll, onboarding and termination (including seasonal staff)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; seasonal onboarding in January; termination drives access removal
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; manual onboarding checklist

description: Single sign-on, MFA, and account changes for every system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every process depends on sign-in; outage stops all SaaS access; vendor SaaS
dependent_people_or_facilities: IT Manager; IT Support Technician; MSP
